Maya R: Hi folks, Im Maya (new AE). HR flow completed but SSO to HubSpot fails with '403: role not assigned'. Also no Gong workspace access, Dialpad asks for MFA setup but the SMS never arrives. Who owns mapping/role assignment and quick access to the enablement playbook?
Sam (Sales Ops): Welcome Maya! Role mapping is done in the identity console by Ops. Can you confirm your Okta email (exact)?
Maya R: maya.r@redwood.ai
Sam (Sales Ops): Thanks. Submitting identity mapping request now. Ticket ID SB-20260323-99. Ill also re-send the Dialpad provisioning and trigger MFA SMS again.
Maya R: Appreciate it. Anything I should check meanwhile?
Lina (Sales Enablement): Hi Maya  welcome! The Playbook + Battlecards live here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-sales-playbooks. For Gong highlight templates see Drive > Sales/Calls/Templates. Ill add you to the enablement cohort channel and drop the week-1 checklist.
Rohit (AE Mentor): Hey Maya  drop me a DM. Happy to run a mock call this week. Quick tip: enable "auto-transcripts" in Gong settings once youre in.
ServiceBot: Identity mapping request submitted by Sam. Ticket SB-20260323-99. Estimated update: 15-45 minutes.
Sam (Sales Ops): Update: Okta mapping applied for maya.r@redwood.ai. HubSpot invite resent. Gong workspace invite resent. Dialpad MFA retried  please reply with the 6-digit code when you get it.
Maya R: Got the Dialpad code and HubSpot invite, thanks! Still no Gong email though (checked spam).
Lina (Sales Enablement): If Gong invite not in inbox, try this link to accept via token: https://gong.accept.link/alpha - if that fails I can manually add you to the team. Also added you to Confluence page "Sales Onboard - Maya R" with role-specific tasks.
Maya R: Token link worked, I'm in. Quick q: where are collateral templates for discovery emails?
Lina (Sales Enablement): Templates in Confluence under "Templates/Email/Discovery" and also in the Sales Kit in HubSpot (snippets). I pasted two starter snippets in #sales-resources.
Rohit (AE Mentor): Added you to my calendar for a 30-min mock on Friday 10am PT. Also: ping me after youve run a couple of dials and Ill review Gong highlights.
Maya R: Thanks everyone! Going to try a test outbound in Dialpad and verify HubSpot contact creation.
Sam (Sales Ops): Closing ticket SB-20260323-99. Reach out if anything borks. :thumbsup:
